title: 88Vape Original Rolling Leaf 10ml E-Liquid
description: Rolling Leaf Tobacco from 88Vape is a rich, full-bodied and flavoursome tobacco flavour that offers all the flavour of a traditional rollie with none of the finger-work. Just pop in your favourite vape device and enjoy a classic toasted tobacco taste. This e-liquid from 88Vape offers a perfect balance of PG and VG, providing delicious flavour, smooth throat yet tactile throat hit and satisfying clouds. They are versatile enough to be used with most vape devices but are ideal for low-powered starter kits, pen-vape kits and pod kits. 88Vape are one of the most popular and bestselling vape brands in the UK. They have helped countless smokers make the switch to the far safer alternative of vaping with the help of delicious e-liquids at budget-friendly prices. Their 30 VG/70 PG e-liquids are suitable for low powered vape devices, so users can enjoy their favourite flavours with the minimum of fuss. Please note: that the 11mg & 16mg nicotine strengths contain 30VG/70PG. They are versatile enough to be used with most vape devices but are ideal for low-powered starter kits, pen-vape kits and pod kits.
